cost.basis: ESTIMATE: explicit USD 0.05/0.15 per million input/output tokens, settled Gemma-4-12B estimate via google/gemma-3-12b-it at the full catalog pair. google/gemma-4-12B-it is unlisted in the frozen pricing module; no base_model key or exact-base floor applies. Native usage priced as reported; uncounted second-prefill estimate of 427,166 input tokens is disclosed and not priced. Common 1,485-item basis USD 0.03469 per 1,000 decisions = 0.537 times cap; all-1,500 basis USD 0.03758 = 0.582 times cap. Estimated, not charged usage or a host quote. If the uncounted prefills were priced as input (403,115 tokens on the common 1,485-item basis), the common-basis cost would be USD 0.048268 per 1,000 decisions, 0.747 times the cap (all-1,500 USD 0.051819, 0.802 times the cap). The Cost axis would fall from 53.79 to 49.49, below the 50-point composite gate. This sensitivity estimate is not included in the published price or scores.
